summary: Leave a lasting legacy at Epiphany..
title: Endowment Fund
intro:
Epiphany has an Endowment Fund. The purpose of the Endowment is to provide funds for the church to use in perpetuity (forever) for capital improvements and outreach.

Between 3% and 5% of the Endowment can be withdrawn annually.

These funds have been used for building improvements, such as the HVAC systems, to support local non-profits providing vital services to the community, and for local schools.

If you want to contribute to the Endowmwnt Fund or include it in your EOL planning, please contact the church office.
